entities.summary: Pio Piacentini was an Italian architect and the father of Marcello Piacentini. His works include the Palazzo delle Esposizioni (1883), the Rinascente palace (1920), the monumental entrance to Villa Sciarra, and Palazzo Piacentini. He also directed the construction works of the Vittoriano since 1905, together with Manfredo Manfredi and Gaetano Koch.
